alternate_titles: Apostolic Constitution defining the dogma of the Assumption
work.author: Pope Pius XII
work.description: The apostolic constitution of 1 November 1950 by which Pius XII solemnly defined the bodily Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary. The Latin original was published in Acta Apostolicae Sedis 42 (1950) 753-771; the definition sentence is Denzinger-Schoenmetzer 3903. The Vatican English web presentation numbers the text in 48 paragraphs, the locus system used here.
